dogecoin.text: @Littlelinkgath1 After Wall Street bets sent the Wake Up Call that the big financial institutions are not invincible Elon Musk pump Dogecoin to show that a token with no value created as a joke was more financially viable than the institutions grasping to maintain power.

Whenever theres a giant crypto dump the $link pullback is less severe relative to the market, which results in smaller relative increases during market pumps. A lack of boom potential doesn't attract  dumb $ as well as $doge but there's a reason smart $ refuses to sell.
